- Radiosondes: RS41 frames are now repaired by their Reed-Solomon code (up to 12 bad bytes in each half), so weak sondes are decoded far more often
- Radiosondes: the current Météo-France M10s (M10+, Gtop GPS) now show their position, altitude and speed; battery voltage for M10, M10+ and M20
- Radiosondes: Horus amateur balloons are decoded again: real frames were rejected by mistake, and frames sent without a preamble were not found. A balloon without a GPS fix no longer appears at 0°, 0°
- POCSAG: a received page no longer waits for the next transmission to be shown, a lost codeword no longer garbles the rest of the text, and numeric pages use the standard's characters
- TPMS: the last bits of a packet are no longer cut off, and noise spikes no longer lose bits. New sensors: Schrader (four formats: Opel/GM, Subaru/Nissan/Renault Koleos, BMW and the original) and Honda TRW. PMV-107J ids have eight digits as in rtl_433
- VDL Mode 2: real bursts are now heard (a radio's shaped signal was rejected at the start of each burst); on a real recording, 33 frames are decoded instead of 3
- Wireless M-Bus: the receiver follows the meter's clock, so telegrams from meters whose crystal is a little off (up to 3 %) are no longer lost
